title: Chapter 1406 - 17: The Yuan Great Emperor, Invincible Among Immortal Kings (Part 2)
content:
Chapter 1406 - 17: The Yuan Great Emperor, Invincible Among Immortal Kings (Part 2)

Chapter 1406: Chapter 17: The Yuan Great Emperor, Invincible Among Immortal Kings (Part 2)

"For Emperor Tianyuan to so easily withstand the pressure of the virtual world, in terms of defense, even if we Immortal Kings were to join forces, I fear we would still be unable to handle him."

"This defense nearly reaches the level of an Immortal Emperor."

Numerous Immortal Kings watched from afar.

Even among Immortal Kings, the strength gap is not too large. The peak of an Immortal King compared to one who has just entered the Immortal King Realm is difficult to overwhelm decisively; the latter can leave whenever they wish.

Thus, Immortal Kings are often unwilling to accept being inferior to another.

Over a dozen Immortal Kings and hundreds of Red Dust Immortals, the reason they divided into five separate immortal paths is not only to more widely interpret areas of the virtual world.

There is also the purpose of minimizing disputes and conflicts as much as possible.

Why has Lin Yuan received goodwill from all the Immortal Kings and Red Dust Immortals? It’s because there are no significant karmic grievances with any of them.

But it is different between the other Immortal Kings.

Yet now, all Immortal Kings are completely convinced of Lin Yuan’s defensive means.

Even if over a dozen Immortal Kings were to join forces, it’s likely they wouldn’t be able to handle Lin Yuan.

"To what kind of Origin Dao does Emperor Tianyuan’s method of defense pertain? Chaotic Origin World Dao? Chaotic Origin Space Dao? It seems like both but also neither."

"This is probably Emperor Tianyuan’s Secret Technique. If it could be easily discerned by you, that would be remarkable indeed."

"Indeed, I feel that the number of Chaotic Origin Daos realized by Emperor Tianyuan is not small, only through the perfect fusion of multiple Chaotic Origin Daos can such terrifying defensive power be produced."

Numerous Immortal Kings conversed among themselves.

Strong individuals at the level of Immortal Kings, as they realize their Origin Daos, will successively realize more Chaotic Origin Daos.

Thereupon, powerful Immortal Kings will use their own Chaotic Origin Dao as the core and integrate other Chaotic Origin Daos to create one Secret Technique after another.

Currently, what they saw of the cosmos outside Lin Yuan’s body, the profundity it contained was not inferior to one Chaotic Origin Dao after another.

...

Close to the virtual world.

Three towering figures sat cross-legged there.

"I never expected that such a strong individual could still emerge in the Great Wilderness Origin World after the Primeval Times?" The towering figure on the left said with a smile.

In the late period of the Primeval Times, the Three-Life Immortal Emperor opened up the main immortal path, bringing many Red Dust Immortals and Immortal Kings into it.

And as the three Immortal Emperors sealed the virtual world, the undead material sourced from the virtual world became much scarcer.

The increasing scarcity of undead material meant that the number and quality of strong individuals born in later generations would decline.

But Lin Yuan?

Even in the Primeval Times, a strong individual like Lin Yuan never appeared.

When the Three-Life Immortal Emperor was still in the Immortal King Realm, it was impossible to possess such terrifying power.

"In him, I sense traces of the ’Three Eras Method,’ Three Eras, could it be that the legacy you left in the Great Wilderness Origin World has been inherited?"

The figure on the right said.

"The ’Three Eras Method’ is my foundation, I have not left behind any related legacy."

The towering figure in the middle shook its head, mainly because even if something had been left behind, it would be of no use.

No outsider could possibly learn it.

"That is indeed interesting."

The towering figure on the right took an interest.

"The strength of this ’Tianyuan’ likely means no opponent exists for him at the Immortal King level."

The towering figure on the left spoke.

In comparison to those Red Dust Immortals and Immortal Kings, their observations of Lin Yuan were more detailed and specific, knowing that Emperor Tianyuan’s measures far exceeded defense alone.

Not to mention other aspects, just the cosmos extended outside Lin Yuan’s body could crush numerous Immortal Kings, not only for defense.

"Indeed."

The towering figure on the right nodded in agreement.

Being an Immortal Emperor, also known as the Time Lord, his perspective was not confined to the Great Wilderness Origin World; he thoroughly understood the vast dimensional gaps surrounding them.

None of the Time Lives in the Second Realm within these dimensional gaps could compare to Lin Yuan.

Lin Yuan could undoubtedly be called invincible among Immortal Kings.

"If such a strong individual were to become an Immortal Emperor, might we have a hope to completely explore the virtual world?"

The towering figure on the left spoke softly.

"Indeed."

The towering figure on the right said.

Now, with the three Immortal Emperors joining forces, they have basically sealed the virtual world at the end of the immortal path.

But sealing does not mean it has been fully explored.

Even now, the three Immortal Emperors are still helpless against the virtual world.

...

Under the leadership of the Reincarnation Immortal King and two other Immortal Kings, a stable immortal path gradually took shape.

And Lin Yuan no longer needed to constantly resist the pressure emanating from the virtual world.

"Hahaha, this immortal path is almost established." The Reincarnation Immortal King laughed.

"Thanks to Tianyuan." Immortal King Bai Bin looked at Lin Yuan, "Tianyuan, you’ve really kept us in the dark. If it weren’t for your display of power this time, who would have known your strength is so formidable? Even the peak Immortal King is no match for you, right?"

"That’s certain." The Reincarnation Immortal King nodded.

He himself was at the peak of the Immortal King level, and he had an accurate assessment of this.

He was definitely not Lin Yuan’s opponent, not even capable of challenging him slightly.

Lin Yuan smiled.

In fact, many of his techniques hadn’t been used yet, although the universe outside his body could be considered one of Lin Yuan’s trump cards.

"After entering the immortal path, I’ve gained many insights, achieving a breakthrough." Lin Yuan said, "It’s merely luck."

"Your luck is rather frightening." Immortal King Wushen couldn’t help but say.

"Alright, this immortal path has been opened, the foremost position is reserved for Tianyuan." The Reincarnation Immortal King said.

An opened stable immortal path, depending on the distance to the virtual world, brought varying levels of insights. Without a doubt, the foremost position closest to the virtual world had the highest efficiency in insights.

"I have no objections."

"Neither do I."

Immortal King Wushen and Immortal King Bai Bin nodded.

They could say, this time, that they thoroughly benefited from Lin Yuan.

Without Lin Yuan, they would probably still be selecting other immortal paths to open; how could they be sitting here discussing all these?

"Then I won’t decline." Lin Yuan didn’t act humbly.

This immortal path was mainly opened by him, so it was right for him to occupy the best position.

"If Tianyuan declines, who would dare to comprehend here?" The Reincarnation Immortal King, Immortal King Bai Bin, and Immortal King Wushen exchanged smiles.

...

While chatting idly with the three Immortal Kings.

Lin Yuan had already started comprehending the virtual world.

The current immortal path where Lin Yuan was located was near the core region of the virtual world. The mysterious insights of the origin dao he could comprehend from there were far superior to those from earlier immortal paths.

Lin Yuan could vaguely see the scenery deep within the virtual world.

[Your understanding is against-heaven...]

...

[Your understanding is against-heaven...]

...

[Your understanding is against-heaven...]

...

A surge of enlightenment flashed through Lin Yuan’s mind, numerous brilliant insights continuously merged and collided, forming new perspectives.

"Can I enter this virtual world?"

A certain desire arose in Lin Yuan’s mind, wanting to enter this virtual world.

Even just comprehending from outside the virtual world had yielded such significant rewards, if he truly entered, wouldn’t stepping into the Third Realm be as simple as eating and drinking?

"Forget it."

Lin Yuan gathered his thoughts and abandoned the idea.

Let’s not mention whether he could actually enter the virtual world; even if he could enter, considering the nature of the virtual world exposed outside, whether he would be affected by it was uncertain.

Anyway, with Lin Yuan’s against-heaven understanding, even comprehending outside would bring unimaginable rewards, so there was no need to risk entering the virtual world.

According to what Lin Yuan knew, the three Immortal Emperors had not entered the virtual world either, but were stationed closer, similarly comprehending.

Even something that Immortal Emperors like the Time Lord couldn’t achieve, Lin Yuan did not plan to attempt by himself.

Time slowly passed.

In the blink of an eye, two hundred years had passed.

Two hundred years of close comprehension of the core region of the virtual world had tremendously benefited Lin Yuan, many chaotic origin daos interwoven in his mind, gradually merging into an origin dao presenting a black and white yin-yang image, vast and mighty.

"The chaotic origin taiji dao is almost comprehended."

A smile appeared on Lin Yuan’s face.

The Red Dust Immortals and Immortal Kings on the immortal path all believed that he was an Immortal King because he had comprehended the chaotic origin destruction dao.

In reality, Lin Yuan’s own chaotic origin taiji dao hadn’t been comprehended yet, his true realm was still in the Thirteen Stage First Realm, which is the Red Dust Immortal.
